name: @ocat/dotfiles
description: macOS dotfiles with multiple shell mode system
author: ocat

scripts.setup: npm run install && npm run install:bundle
scripts.setup:minimal: npm run install && npm run install:cargo
scripts.health: npm run doctor && npm run validate
scripts.backup: tar -czf ~/dotfiles-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz -C ~ .zshrc .zshenv .vimrc .gitconfig 2>/dev/null || echo 'Backup completed with some warnings'
scripts.clean: brew cleanup && cargo cache -a && find . -name '*.log' -type f -delete && find . -name '*.tmp' -type f -delete && find . -name '.DS_Store' -type f -delete
scripts.lint: shellcheck ./**/*.sh || echo 'Install shellcheck for better linting'
scripts.status: git status && echo '---' && npm run health
scripts.info: echo 'Dotfiles Info:' && git log --oneline -5 && echo '---' && brew --version && cargo --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'cargo not available'
scripts.symlinks: find ~ -maxdepth 1 -type l -ls | grep dotfiles || echo 'No dotfiles symlinks found'
scripts.serve:docs: python3 -m http.server 8000 -d . || echo 'Start a simple HTTP server to serve documentation'
scripts.benchmark: hyperfine 'zsh -i -c exit' 'bash -i -c exit' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Install hyperfine for shell benchmarking'
